Matchup Assistant

All-play performance, strength of schedule, and category rankings across the league — pick a season and a team below, updated from the weekly archive.
Showing built-in snapshot

Snapshot

Weekly Pulse

All-play record out of 11 possible opponents. Gold ring marks the viewing team; dots flag undefeated / winless weeks. Pick the week up in the header, next to season and team.

4-Week Rolling Trend

Trailing 4-week all-play win%, updated weekly. Ramps up week-by-week until the window is full, then rolls.

Season Standings & Schedule Strength

All-play win% is a team's record if it played every league member every week. Opponent win% / Schedule Strength is the average all-play win% of the real opponents actually faced — a higher bar means a tougher slate. Click any column header to sort.

Round-Robin: Every Team vs. Every Team

Hypothetical result if the row team had played the column team head-to-head every week this season, reconstructed from weekly category scores. Cell shows the row team's W-L-T against that opponent. Click a header to sort teams by their record vs. that opponent.

Season Category Rankings

Season totals per category, ranked 1 (best) to 12 (worst) — direction already accounts for categories where lower is better. Click a column header to sort by that category's rank.

Category Performance Distribution

Box plot of all 12 teams' output in each category: the box spans Q1–Q3, the thick line is the league median, and the whiskers reach the full min–max range. The ◆ marks the viewing team, colored only when it sits clearly above/below the league median in the direction that's actually good for that category — categories where a lower number is better (strikeouts by hitters, losses, home runs allowed, ERA, WHIP) are scored accordingly.
Viewing team Better than league median Worse than league median ≈Full-season figure is an approximation (hover for why) — shown on WHIP/OBP when the workbook lacks the raw data to compute it exactly
2018–2025 are frozen archives baked into this page. 2026 updates live: use “Update 2026 data” above to upload your current Matchup Assistant.xlsm/.xlsx (saved from Excel, so it has computed values) — the file is parsed entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded anywhere, and the result is cached locally so it's still there next time you open this page. The built-in 2026 snapshot until then reflects whatever was baked in at last publish.
